doc: Generated call-glue: `jal ra,memmove` at 0x800143c0 composed with `memmove_fwd_spec` (SnprintfSpec18); pins x10/x12/x8 + the jal link carried across the callee via `pins_of_frame`. Post is abstract, discharged by the `hclose` hypothesis.

structure MemmoveCallGluePreGen (d s w8 : BitVec 64) (n : Nat)
    (m0 : Std.ExtHashMap Nat (BitVec 8)) (bs : Nat → BitVec 8) (c : Config) : Prop where
  good : GoodState c.σ
  loaded : Vsa.Sim.Code.__ssputs_rLoaded c.σ.mem
  mvloaded : Vsa.Sim.Code.MemmoveLoaded m0
  pc : c.σ.regs.get? Register.PC = some ((0x800143c0#64) : BitVec 64)
  a0 : c.σ.regs.get? Register.x10 = some d
  a1 : c.σ.regs.get? Register.x11 = some s
  a2 : c.σ.regs.get? Register.x12 = some (BitVec.ofNat 64 n)
  s0 : c.σ.regs.get? Register.x8 = some w8
  minstret : ∃ v, c.σ.regs.get? Register.minstret = some v
  tick : c.tick < 2
  regions : MvRegions d s n
  hbs : MvBytes m0 s n bs
  memeq : c.σ.mem = m0
pre: MemmoveCallGluePreGen d s w8 n m0 bs

pre_bind.obtain: ⟨hgood, hloadp, hmvload, hpcp, ha0, ha1, ha2, hw8, ⟨vmi0, hmi0⟩, htick0, hregions, hbs0, hmemeq0⟩

prelude: have hssm0 : Vsa.Sim.Code.__ssputs_rLoaded m0 := hmemeq0 ▸ hloadp

steps.args: (fun R => $sigma.regs.get? R) (0x800143c4#64) d s n m0 bs (by decide)
steps.post_obtain: ⟨hGc, hpcc, hx10c, hx1c, hcopied, hmemfr, htickc, hregfr⟩
loaded_lines: ssputs_frame_ss m0 c$k.σ.mem (fun a ha => hmemfr a (Or.inl (by omega))) hssm0

∀ a, (a < d.toNat ∨ d.toNat + n ≤ a) → σ'.mem[a]? = m0[a]?
